$comment: Lighthouse CI config — the SINGLE source of truth for the performance gate. Docs: https://github.com/GoogleChrome/lighthouse-ci/blob/main/docs/configuration.md. Every assertion below is `error`-level, so `lhci assert` (pnpm lighthouse:assert) exits non-zero and FAILS CI on any regression. RESOURCE BUDGETS are expressed as `resource-summary:<type>:size` assertions in BYTES (KB x 1024): script 200 KB, stylesheet 50 KB, image 500 KB. This is the only budget mechanism compatible with the bundled Lighthouse 12, which REMOVED the legacy budgets.json/budgetsPath + `performance-budget`/`timing-budget` audits (asserting on those now fails with 'not a known audit'); lhci's `budgetsFile` option also can't be combined with the category `assertions` here. `resource-summary` size is the over-the-wire transferSize — i.e. the gzip/brotli size when the server compresses text assets. Mobile preset is the Lighthouse default, kept implicit. `collect.settings.skipAudits` drops audits that can only fail because CI serves http://localhost (is-on-https is ~17% of best-practices and always fails on http; uses-http2 is a weight-0 perf diagnostic) — they are environment artifacts, not theme-quality signals. To change a threshold or budget, edit it here and follow CONTRIBUTING.md -> 'Performance budgets'.
